title: pi-do config
description: ~/.pi-do/config.json (global) or a project's .pi-do/config.json. Project overrides global; PI_DO_* env overrides both.

id.description: Project id, written by pi-do. Links this project to its record in ~/.pi-do/projects/projects.jsonl; don't edit.

scope.description: Where todos live: in the project (.pi-do), in ~/.pi-do/projects, or a temporary per-session file. Set per project with /todos scope.

file.description: Explicit todos file path; ~ is expanded. Overridden by PI_DO_FILE.

adapters.description: Sync pi-do todos with other task apps.
